verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v1: ʾinnī ʾataytu l-ʾawwalā ʾarjū l-qirā mubtahilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v2: walā tuʾākhidhan lanā bimā ʾataynā khaṭalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v3: qarrāʿu bābika ftaḥan lahu d-dukhūla sahilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v4: famālahu min ḥīlati munna ʿalayhi l-ḥiyalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v5: waʿāmilan lahu bimā ʿāmaltahu man fuḍalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v6: faʾanta rabbī ʾahluhu ʾin lam yakun muʾahalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v7: wāghfir lanā dhunūbanā bijāhi hādi ʾursilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v10: mithla ṣalāti qad ʾatā muḥibbuhu mumtathilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v11: sallam salāmā rabbanā salāma ḥibbi ʿadalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v12: ṣalli ʿalā l-musrā bihi ʾilayka laylā fāʿtalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v15: ṣalli ṣalāta lā nihā yata lahā madā l-malā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v16: mithla kamālika lladhī lā muntahā lahu anjalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v17: ʿadda kamālihi ḥabī bika lladhī tabajjala
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v18: rabbi jziyan ghawtha l-warā ʾaḥmada tāji l-fuḍalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v19: bna l-karīmi bni l-karī mi bni l-karīmi l-budalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v21: kun lit-tajāni rāḍiyā waman bihi tadhayyalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v22: wakun waliyyā nāṣirā waqihimu ʾahla l-qilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v23: wahabhum waman qafā dukhūla jannati l-ʿulā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v25: lā siyyamā badri d-dujā khatmihimi badri l-malā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v26: l-ʿurwati l-wuthqā lanā ʾidhā shtidādu nazalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v27: ṭūbā lanā ṭūbā lanā nilnā l-munā wan-niḥalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v28: laqad ʾatānā mā bihi maḥwu l-khaṭā dafʿu l-balā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v29: mustamsiku biḥablihi yawma lliqā mā huwwilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v32: wanayla ghufrāni lladhī ʾawqaʿtu minhu khalalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v33: daʿū l-bunayyāti llatī yanmū lahu man jahilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v34: waman ʿadhā l-mīthāʾa yal qā ghālibā muḍallilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v35: ʾazkā salāmi dāʾimā ʿalā nabiyyi dhī ʿtilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v37: mā ḥanna ʿāshiqu ʾilā ṭaybatihi yabghī l-ʾilā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v38: ʾamātanā llāhu ʿalā dīni n-nabiyyī dhī l-ʿulā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v8: muḥammadi khayri l-warā l-maṣdūqi ṣāḥibi l-khalā
verses.inni-ataytu-l-awwala-c1-v30: yā fawza man jaʿalahu l-ʾimāma wal-muʿawwalā
